proposed_widenings.name: choice_spell_family
proposed_widenings.justification: Prestidigitation's core structure is 'at cast time, choose one of N distinct options, each with its own effect.' No existing spell family models this. The four current families (ongoing_effect, activation, triggered_reaction, anchored_trigger) all assume a single fixed payload shape; none has a choice-from-menu dispatch.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You create a magical effect within range. Choose the effect from the options below.

proposed_widenings.name: create_sensory_effect (Effect variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: The Sensory Effect option produces an instantaneous harmless sensory phenomenon. The current Effect union (DamageEffect | NoneEffect) cannot represent this. A 'create_sensory_effect' effect variant or an 'environmental_effect' family is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You create an instantaneous, harmless sensory effect, such as a shower of sparks, a puff of wind, faint musical notes, or an odd odor.

proposed_widenings.name: manipulate_object_state (Effect variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: Fire Play and Clean/Soil produce deterministic state changes on environmental objects (a fire is lit or extinguished; an object is clean or soiled). No Effect type covers object-state manipulation. The v4 taxonomy has 'create_object' and 'alter_item_kind' but neither maps to toggling fire or cleanliness.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You instantaneously light or snuff out a candle, a torch, or a small campfire. / You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_material_property (Effect variant, timed)
proposed_widenings.justification: Minor Sensation modifies a material property (temperature, flavor) for a timed duration. This is a deterministic, non-damage, non-condition effect with no existing surface representation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You chill, warm, or flavor up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving material for 1 hour.

proposed_widenings.name: apply_visual_mark (Effect variant, timed)
proposed_widenings.justification: Magic Mark places a visual marking on an object or surface for 1 hour. Attachment target is an object or surface (v4 atoms 'object'/'location'), neither of which is in the Attachment type. Effect type for applying a cosmetic mark is also absent.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour.

proposed_widenings.name: create_object (Effect variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: 'create_object' exists in the v4 atom taxonomy but is absent from the surface types.ts Effect union. Minor Creation requires it. The trinket has a bounded duration (end of next turn) and explicit zero-damage, zero-monetary-worth constraints.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You create a nonmagical trinket or an illusory image that can fit in your hand. It lasts until the end of your next turn. A trinket can deal no damage and has no monetary worth.

proposed_widenings.name: object / surface (Attachment kind)
proposed_widenings.justification: Several Prestidigitation options target objects or surfaces, not creatures or areas. The Attachment type has no 'object' or 'surface' kind. v4 taxonomy lists 'object' and 'location' attachment atoms.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You instantaneously clean or soil an object no larger than 1 cubic foot. / You make a color, a small mark, or a symbol appear on an object or a surface for 1 hour.

notes: No dhall or JSON authored: no existing SpellMechanics family can honestly encode this spell. The structural gap is the choice-from-menu dispatch (six independent options at cast time), which is absent from all four current families. Even if a new family were added, five of the six effect options require new Effect variant types (clean/soil, fire toggle, temperature/flavor, visual mark, object creation). The effects are deterministic — not DM-adjudicated — so dm_agenda does not apply. The 'up to three non-instantaneous effects active at a time' constraint is an additional instance-count mechanic with no current surface representation.
